race.title: Pat Carroll's Pub Kilkenny Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
race.verdict: POETIC FOCUS looks to have plenty going for her and can gain compensation for a near miss at Clonmel last time. Eaglewood , Talas Kera and Frontier Rose are likely dangers in a competitive handicap. POETIC FOCUS (IRE) EAGLEWOOD (IRE) TALAS KERA (IRE)
